question: How do I split several VAT rates on one supplier invoice?
expected_location: Split VAT rates on a supplier invoice
reference_answer: In Supplier invoices, open the invoice (it must be in Inbox or In review) and add one VAT split per rate: pick the VAT account, put that rate's tax in Tax amount, and click + VAT split. The cost lines and VAT lines must add up to the invoice totals before you can submit or approve.

question: How do I update the details on an invoice already created, such as the PO number or description?
expected_location: Update invoice details
reference_answer: In Invoices, click More actions on the invoice row, then Edit description, type the new text and Save. It prints on the PDF above the lines. To refresh the client's details use Sync contact; the number, amount and status do not change.

question: How do I create a chapter (section) and add cost lines to it?
expected_location: Turn a cost line into a chapter
reference_answer: Open the estimate and double-click the § at the left of a cost line, confirming Convert if the line has values (its amounts are cleared for good). The line name becomes the chapter title, and the lines that follow sit under it. Add cost lines under the chapter as usual.

question: How do I create a credit note for an invoice that was already issued?
expected_location: Create a credit note
reference_answer: Click the invoice's Credit note action (More actions menu). In the drawer enter a Credit amount and a Note. A credit note can be partial, but amounts beyond what is still creditable are blocked.

question: How can I add a discount to an estimate?
expected_location: Apply a discount to an estimate
reference_answer: In the estimate summary click Apply Discount and type the total you want to charge, excluding VAT, in Total After Discount, then Save. Chedar works out the discount amount. To change it use the pencil, to remove it click Remove Discount.

question: What do the different user roles allow people to do?
expected_location: Add, change or remove a team member
reference_answer: Viewer can only read; Production manager works on projects, estimates and POs and approves supplier invoices in Inbox but sees no clients, proposals or client invoices; Member does everything day to day but no reports, banking or most company settings; Company admin can do everything, including reports, banking, accounting exports and Team.

question: How do I change the language, the logo or the PDF design of my documents?
expected_location: Set the colours and logo of your PDFs;User settings: every button explained
reference_answer: Colours and logos are set in Settings > Visual settings: fill PDF primary and secondary colour under PDF colors and upload a logo in the Logo library (Company admin or Member). The language is not set there: it is your own Language choice in User settings.

question: Why does 'Mark as ready' do nothing, or why can't I issue the invoice?
expected_location: Mark as Ready does nothing, or I cannot issue the invoice
reference_answer: Mark as ready stays greyed out until both Invoice date and Due date are filled. Other causes are the client and split not being saved, installments adding up to more than the total, or the client lacking an accounting account (Auxiliary account name, or an accounting mapping in Accounting Categories).

question: How do I keep several versions of the same estimate and go back to an earlier one?
expected_location: Save a version of an estimate
reference_answer: Open the estimate, click the clock icon (Versions) in the toolbar, optionally add a Label, and click Save version. Each version is a numbered read-only copy: open it to view it, or use Duplicate as new estimate to get an editable copy of it. The estimate must not be finalized, and the limit is 24 versions.

question: How do I merge several estimates into a single new estimate?
expected_location: Merge estimates into a new estimate
reference_answer: In the project's Contents tab click Merge estimates, pick a base estimate, then up to 20 others in the same currency, review the check screen and click Save. The new estimate takes its header and rates from the base; the originals do not change. Saved versions cannot be merged.

question: How do I generate a SEPA payment file for supplier payments?
expected_location: Export a SEPA payment file
reference_answer: In Supplier invoices > To pay, click Export > SEPA, choose the Bank profile, SEPA version (v8), Mode and Entry date, then Generate and upload the file to your bank. Every supplier needs an IBAN, and only euro bills in To pay are included.

question: How do I download or preview the estimate as a PDF?
expected_location: Preview the estimate PDF
reference_answer: Open the estimate, click Summary, then Preview PDF to see the client PDF in the panel. Click Download PDF to save it. The PDF only generates if terms are saved for the template type and language.

question: How do I move an estimate to another project?
expected_location: Move an estimate to another project
reference_answer: On the estimate's row in Estimates (or the project's Contents tab) click the Move icon, choose the destination project and click Move here, then Confirm move. A finalized estimate cannot be moved, nor one with purchase order or supplier invoice lines tied to its current project.

question: How do I download an invoice as a PDF in another language?
expected_location: Download an Invoice PDF or a ZIP of Invoices;User settings: every button explained
reference_answer: In Invoices, click Download on the invoice row (or tick up to 50 and use Download as ZIP). There is no language option on the download: the PDF follows the language the app is using, which you switch with the Language button in User settings.

question: How can I limit which projects a team member can see?
expected_location: Limit which projects a person can see
reference_answer: A Company admin goes to Settings > Team, ticks Limit people to their assigned projects, then clicks the Projects link on the person's row, ticks their projects and Saves. It only applies to Viewers and Production managers; Members and Company admins always see everything.

question: How do social charges work on payroll cost lines in an estimate?
expected_location: Payroll charges in a production estimate
reference_answer: Chedar adds employer charges on top of each line's cost using one rate per band, taken from the template. The charges are added to the payroll section, then insurance and margin follow. The rates are starting values you can edit, or set to None or 0 for no charges.

question: How do I change or reset the invoice numbering?
expected_location: Document numbering: every button explained
reference_answer: Go to Settings > Document numbering and set the Invoice number prefix (the same prefix applies to credit notes), then Save. The counter restarts at 0001 each year and numbers already given do not change. The page has no button to reset the counter manually.

question: How do I edit the categories and cost lines of a template?
expected_location: Edit an estimate template
reference_answer: Go to Templates, click the template, then Edit. Click a cell (Name, Qty, Nb, Rate) to change defaults, + to add a line and § to make a chapter, then click Publish. Changes stay a draft until published, and existing estimates are not changed.

question: How do I show the estimate in a different currency or change the exchange rate used?
expected_location: What is the difference between a line’s currency and the estimate’s currency?
reference_answer: The estimate has one currency (Edit Budget > Financial parameters > Currency) and all totals and the PDF use it. Individual lines can be priced in another Currency, and the Exch. Rate column on the line converts it; Chedar fills it in, and you can type it yourself.

question: How do I mark an invoice as paid, and what do the invoice statuses mean?
expected_location: Mark an invoice as paid;The Invoices list: where your client invoices live
reference_answer: In Invoices, click the Mark paid icon on a Pending or Overdue invoice, check the Paid date and Confirm. Statuses: Pending (not paid, not yet due), Overdue (past due date), Paid, Credit note issued (partly credited), Fully credited, and Credit note. Credit note status wins over Paid.

question: Which email notifications can I turn on or off?
expected_location: Choose which emails you receive
reference_answer: Under Settings > Notifications you can toggle: Email me about overdue to-dos (daily 9am Paris round-up, off by default), Email me when somebody replies (on by default), and Email me tips while my company is new (on by default). They only affect your own emails and save immediately.

question: How do I export the accounting entries (FEC) for my accountant?
expected_location: Export the FEC and the accounting entries
reference_answer: A Company admin goes to Reports > Accounting, enters the Year in the Compliant FEC card and clicks Download FEC, which gives FEC-<year>.txt. The company needs the Premium plan, and the file can be downloaded again as many times as needed.

question: After issuing a deposit invoice, the estimate changed. How do I update the balance invoice without losing the deposit?
expected_location: The Proposals list: what each row and status means;Mark a draft as ready and issue the invoice
reference_answer: After the estimate changes, click Refresh on the proposal row in Proposals: it updates the total and recalculates installments not yet invoiced, and issued invoices (the deposit) are never touched. Then open Generate for the balance installment, set the dates, tick Mark as ready and click Issue invoice.

question: A new employee must see only certain projects and must not see invoices. How do I set this up?
expected_location: Add, change or remove a team member;Limit which projects a person can see
reference_answer: Make them a Production manager (or Viewer), who can't see clients, proposals or client invoices, and a Company admin ticks Limit people to their assigned projects in Settings > Team and assigns the person's projects. Members and admins always see every project and invoices, so they would not fit.

question: What role does my accountant need, and how do I give them access to the accounting export?
expected_location: Add, change or remove a team member;Export the FEC and the accounting entries
reference_answer: Your outside accountant takes no paid seat: use Want to add your accountant for free? under the Add form in Settings > Team and Chedar support adds them. The FEC export (Reports > Accounting) is visible only to Company admins and needs the Premium plan, otherwise you download and send the exports yourself.

question: How do I set up e-invoicing and check that my clients will receive invoices through it?
expected_location: Set up e-invoicing;The e-invoicing reform in France
reference_answer: A Company admin goes to Settings > Electronic invoicing, fills the legal details (SIREN, Fill from the registry), uploads the Kbis and onboards with Sage Network (optionally Billit). Once Sage is Connected, click Check integration health. Invoices are sent automatically if the client has a French VAT number or a SIREN with France as country.

question: How do I compare budget and actual costs on a billed production, and what do the margin figures mean?
expected_location: Read the wrap report: budget against actual for billed productions;Read the portfolio margin
reference_answer: A Company admin opens Reports > Wrap Report for budget against actual (Budget, Actual, Variance, Variance %) on billed productions, with a status from On track to Critical. Portfolio Margin compares margin to a Target margin: Provisional is planned margin, Actual is the total minus real costs; Blended margin is the weighted average.

question: I issued an invoice with the wrong VAT rate. How do I cancel it and issue a corrected one?
expected_location: Create a credit note;Update invoice details
reference_answer: Create a credit note from the invoice (Credit note action, up to the creditable amount, full if needed) to cancel it, then issue a corrected invoice. Edit description and Sync contact only change the printed description and client details, not amounts or VAT, and do not change the invoice's number or status.

question: I issued a purchase order, received the supplier's invoice and want to link it to the same cost line. What are the steps?
expected_location: Issue a purchase order and send it to the supplier;Assign an invoice to a project, a PO line or overhead
reference_answer: Issue the PO first (Mark as ready to issue, then Issue). When the supplier invoice arrives, open it in Supplier invoices and in Cost split pick the PO's line in PO line (optional), check the Amount and click + Cost split. The PO then shows Billed once linked invoices cover every line.

question: How do I export a month of supplier invoices to my accounting software, and check that the account numbers are right?
expected_location: Export supplier invoices to accounting;Set up your cost accounts
reference_answer: In Costs > Supplier invoices, open Not exported, click Export > Accounting, choose a Format, set From and To dates and click Not yet exported. Only approved invoices are exported. To check account numbers, review Settings > Cost accounts and the default supplier cost account in Accounting preferences.
